projection_rule: Keep all 80 calibration and 60 policy/final families. Tasks preserve IDs, raw logits, recorded answer and gold; retain same-entity choice_info, source/panel and gold support/sufficiency. No model weights, text corpus or inference.

fixed_metric_rules.temperature_selection: equal-family, equal-three-types NLL; ties closest to1 then smallerT
fixed_metric_rules.policy_selection: maximum coverage with positive accepts and empirical accepted error<=0.05, ties higher threshold; no feasible policy means all handoff
fixed_metric_rules.accepted_rule: calibrated p_max>=tau AND chosen ID != none AND same-entity choice_info prediction=yes
fixed_metric_rules.accepted_error: choice wrong OR world unsupported OR gold required information insufficient
fixed_metric_rules.scope: single project-authored rule-world generator; held-out state wording template is not independent corpus/pretraining-unseen evidence

promotion_projection.failed_module_default: retain historical product; publish new weights as labelled research candidate

data_source_scope: One project-authored rule-world generator. source names denote authored surface templates; Chinese changes state rendering while questions remain English. held-out means a wholly held-out wording template, not an independent corpus/source or unseen-pretraining claim.
